overview: The Kronenwetter Police and Fire Commission voted unanimously to accept Mason Hoffmann and Jarret Imlach as full members of the Kronenwetter Fire Department upon completion of their probationary periods. The commission also spent nearly an hour and forty-five minutes in closed session on a personnel matter, then voted 5-0 to continue investigating a complaint dated June 30, 2026. All actions carried 5-0.
committee: Police and Fire Commission - Village of Kronenwetter

agenda.item: Discussion and possible action to accept Mason Hoffmann and Jarret Imlach as full members of the Kronenwetter Fire Department after completion of their probationary periods
Closed session pursuant to Wis. Stat. § 19.85(1)(f) regarding personnel matter

discussions.body: Vice President Rick Smith moved, seconded by Commissioner Donna Rule, to approve the July 27, 2026 meeting minutes with a correction noting that Vice President Smith arrived late rather than being absent. The motion carried 5-0 by voice vote.

discussions.item: Acceptance of Mason Hoffmann and Jarret Imlach as full members of the Kronenwetter Fire Department
discussions.body: Vice President Smith moved to accept the Fire Chief's recommendation to elevate Mason Hoffmann and Jarret Imlach to full membership in the Kronenwetter Fire Department following completion of their probationary periods. Commissioner Lucene Udulutch seconded the motion, which carried 5-0 by voice vote.

discussions.item: Closed session and action on personnel complaint
discussions.body: Commissioner Rule moved and Vice President Smith seconded a motion to convene into closed session under Wis. Stat. § 19.85(1)(f) to address a personnel matter. The commission entered closed session at 5:05 p.m. and reconvened in open session at 6:50 p.m. Following closed session, Vice President Smith moved to continue investigating the complaint dated June 30, 2026, seconded by Commissioner Udulutch; the motion carried 5-0 by voice vote.

actionItems: Mason Hoffmann and Jarret Imlach are to be accepted as full members of the Kronenwetter Fire Department upon completion of their respective probationary periods.
The commission directed that the investigation into the complaint dated June 30, 2026 continue.
